$comment: Console route → MCP tool / CLI command map, checked by scripts/check-surface-parity.mjs (pnpm check:surface-parity). Keys are METHOD + Hono path. Each entry names "mcp" tools, "cli" commands (without 'mushi'), or an "allow" reason code from "reasons"; "note" is free text. "dynamicCalls" maps an admin file to the first-argument text of a console call whose path the check cannot resolve, with the reason; a listed call that no longer exists fails as stale. "computedPaths" maps an admin file to a path (each ${…} written as ${}) that fills a static server segment at run time, with the reason; it is stale the same way.

reasons.jwt-only: The route accepts only a signed-in console session (jwtAuth). MCP tools and the CLI authenticate with an API key, so they cannot call it. Widening its auth is a deliberate decision; after that, map a tool or command here.
reasons.public: Unauthenticated or signature-checked endpoint (public pages, invitation preview, webhook receivers, push key). The console links to it or calls it anonymously; it is not an operator action.
reasons.console-ui: Feeds console chrome only (sidebar badges, page stat strips). The data behind it is reachable through the mapped list or detail route.
reasons.voice-inbox: Voice intake has its own clients (iOS Shortcut, Slack, Telegram, the installed console PWA) that call it with a voice:write key; the console page is one of those clients.
reasons.credentials: Enters, replaces or revokes a stored secret or OAuth grant. It stays in the console, where the secret is typed once and never echoed.
reasons.editor-equivalent: The editor reaches the same capability through a different route, named in "note".
reasons.ci-ingest: Written by the host app's CI or SDK with an ingest key (apiKeyAuth), not by an operator. The console only shows the URL so CI can be pointed at it; the data it stores is read back through the mapped admin route.
reasons.parity-debt: Accepts an API key but has no MCP tool or CLI command yet. Listed so the debt is visible and can only shrink: add the surface, then replace this entry.

DELETE /v1/admin/integrations/platform/:.note: The integration card's Remove key (owner/admin). Deleting a stored credential stays a deliberate console action.

DELETE /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/c.note: ask_codebase (POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/chat) answers in the editor; these routes are the console chat's stream and thread history.

GET /v1/admin/byok/anthropic/models.note: The settings model pickers (ADR 0039): Anthropic GET /v1/models for the key the app's LLM calls use, cached an hour; the console falls back to its built-in list. A key never leaves the server.

GET /v1/admin/byok/cursor/models.note: The review follow-up model picker (ADR 0032): Cursor GET /v1/models for one key, or for the key the app would use. Another app's key needs an organization owner or admin. The Run in the cloud card reads the app key's list through GET /v1/admin/integrations/cursor/models.

GET /v1/admin/byok/review-followups.note: Review follow-up settings, the organization's Cursor keys and the latest follow-ups (ADR 0032). The scoreboard reaches MCP and the CLI through GET /v1/admin/byok/spend-down (reviewFollowups). Per-app settings with CLI/MCP are BL-100.

POST /v1/admin/ci/placement/requests/:id.note: ADR 0037: a person signed in to the console (owner or admin) approves; an API key can only ask.
ADR 0037: console owners and admins decide.
ADR 0037: a change to where CI runs is executed from the console only.

GET /v1/admin/ci/policy.note: The organization's CI agreement for the console form. CLI and MCP read it inside GET /v1/admin/ci/placement (policy).

GET /v1/admin/pipeline.note: Console /pipeline: stages, stuck groups and release trains. The editor reads one fix with get_fix_timeline and get_fix_verification.

POST /v1/admin/pipeline/actions.note: Console /pipeline one-click fixes (CI repair, update branch, conflict agent, mark ready, remove or close with a reason, run the merge queue now); each changes a PR or queue row a person confirmed.

PUT /v1/admin/projects/:id/release-setti.note: ADR 0044: how an app ships approved fixes (release trains or each PR), set on /fixes.

PUT /v1/admin/ci/policy.note: ADR 0037: owners and admins save it in the console; only an owner lifts the no-spend rule.

GET /v1/admin/ci/cost-settings.note: The organization's CI cost figures (electricity, wear, GitHub plan, machines) for Settings → CI cost. The figures reach MCP and the CLI inside GET /v1/admin/ci/compare (settings).

GET /v1/admin/fixes/dispatch/:id/stream.note: The console's live view of one dispatch. The editor follows a fix with get_fix_timeline after dispatch_fix; the terminal with `mushi fix --wait` or `mushi fixes tail`.

GET /v1/admin/integrations/cursor/models.note: Model picker of the console's Run in the cloud card. The terminal reads the same list straight from Cursor with `mushi ux models --agent cursor-cloud`.

GET /v1/admin/orgs/:orgId/accounts/expor.note: The register as Markdown. get_accounts_register returns the same data as JSON in the editor.

GET /v1/admin/orgs/:orgId/monetization.note: The Monetization card's hub view. The same per-app findings (monetization_* rules) reach the editor through get_radar and list_gate_findings, and the attach action through request_connector_action.

GET /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/chat.note: ask_codebase (POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/chat) answers in the editor; these routes are the console chat's stream and thread history.
ask_codebase (POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/chat) answers in the editor; these routes are the console chat's stream and thread history.

GET /v1/admin/projects/:id/vulnerabiliti.note: Known holes (ADR 0038). The same findings reach the editor as the known_vulnerable_dependency and runtime_end_of_life rules through get_radar and `mushi radar show`, and as gate portfolio_radar_vulns through list_gate_findings; the filed reports through get_recent_reports.

GET /v1/admin/projects/:id/recipe/change.note: The console's live view of one recipe change job. The editor reads the job with get_recipe_change; the terminal with `mushi recipe change <jobId>`.

GET /v1/admin/projects/:pid/ux-runs/:run.note: Live state of the PR a UX run opened, for the console's Merge button. In a terminal or editor the same PR is `gh pr view` / `gh pr checks`.

GET /v1/admin/projects/:pid/pull-request.note: Open PRs of the project's connected repos with their required checks, for the Pull requests page's Merge button. In a terminal or editor: `gh pr list` / `gh pr checks`.

GET /v1/sdk/latest-version.note: Anonymous npm catalog lookup. The console reads it to pin the published @mushi-mushi/mcp version into install configs; the CLI and MCP check versions with mushi upgrade / check_sdk_version.

PATCH /v1/admin/byok/keys/:keyId/scope.note: Moving a key between app, organization and universal scope changes what other apps bill to, so the route refuses API keys (ADR 0023, ADR 0031); the console is the surface.

PATCH /v1/admin/byok/review-followups.note: Organization owners and admins choose the Cursor key, model and daily limit review follow-ups spend across every app (ADR 0032), like a shared key (ADR 0023): a console decision, never an API key.

PATCH /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/ch.note: ask_codebase (POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/chat) answers in the editor; these routes are the console chat's stream and thread history.

PATCH /v1/admin/projects/:id/vulnerabili.note: Dismissing a known hole is a person's decision in a console session; jwtAuth refuses API keys, so an agent cannot hide its own findings (the gate-findings dismiss rule).

POST /v1/admin/byok/spend-down/projects/.note: Resume on a paused spend-down app (ADR 0028 stop-loss). Restarting spend is an owner/admin console decision, like changing a shared key.

POST /v1/admin/fixes/:id/review.note: Re-runs the Opus review of a fix PR (ADR 0030). The editor reads the verdict with get_fix_timeline and overrides a hold with merge_fix override.

POST /v1/admin/fixes/:id/verify.note: `mushi fixes verify <fixId> --rerun` asks fix-verifier to re-check the fix now (ADR 0035).

POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/cha.note: ask_codebase (POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/codebase/chat) answers in the editor; these routes are the console chat's stream and thread history.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/sdk-health/t.note: Console Fix buttons on SDK health. The task is a classified report, so the CLI and MCP see it with every other report.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:id/verify-workf.note: Opens a PR in the project's repo from the console; `mushi verify workflow` prints the same YAML to commit yourself.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:pid/gate-findin.note: Dismissing a finding with a reason is a person's decision in a console session; jwtAuth refuses API keys, so an agent cannot hide its own findings. A new run of the check is the terminal's way to clear a stale finding.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:pid/content-qua.note: Bulk dismiss is a person's decision with a required reason and an in-page count confirmation; no API-key or agent path.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:pid/ux-runs/:ru.note: Merging is a person's click in a console session (ADR 0017); jwtAuth refuses API keys. The terminal merges with `gh pr merge`.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:pid/pull-reques.note: Merging is a person's click in a console session (ADR 0017); jwtAuth refuses API keys. The terminal merges with `gh pr merge`.

POST /v1/admin/projects/:pid/ux-runs/clo.note: Starts a run that spends the host's Actions minutes and Cursor credits, so only a console session may (ADR 0017, ADR 0020 addendum). The terminal runs the same pass locally with `mushi ux run`, or on CI with `gh workflow run mushi-ux.yml`.

PUT /v1/admin/projects/:id/verify-settin.note: Verified merge settings (ADR 0035). Turning automatic merge on stays a person's decision in the console.

PUT /v1/admin/projects/:id/vulnerabiliti.note: How many security reports Mushi files a day (ADR 0038) is a project setting changed in the console.

PUT /v1/admin/projects/:pid/ux-runs/:run.note: Written by `mushi ux run --sync` (the @mushi-mushi/ux loop); the console only reads the run.

apps/admin/src/components/pdca-flow/Pipe.judgeRunEndpoint: A prop that defaults to '/v1/admin/judge/run' (mapped as POST /v1/admin/judge/run); the only caller, PdcaFlow, passes none.

apps/admin/src/components/notifications/./v1/admin/reporter-outbox/${}/${}: action is typed 'release' | 'discard', exactly the two POST routes under /reporter-outbox/:id; both are mapped.

apps/admin/src/components/report-detail/./v1/admin/tester-submissions/${}/${}: action is ReviewAction ('accept' | 'informative' | 'duplicate' | 'spam'), exactly the four POST routes under /tester-submissions/:id; all are mapped.

apps/admin/src/lib/reporterEmailLink.ts./v1/public/reporter/email/${}?t=${}: link.action is ReporterEmailAction ('verify' | 'unsubscribe'), checked by parseReporterEmailLink before the call; both paths (GET and POST each) are mapped as public.

apps/admin/src/pages/AntiGamingPage.tsx./v1/admin/tester-redemptions/${}/${}: action is typed 'approve' | 'deny', exactly the two POST routes under /tester-redemptions/:id; both are mapped.
